sorry_inventory.assumption: 2-var NF agreement + Prior structure → second component 1-var agreement
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Requires Prior zone-matching (UZ/SZ constrain which existentials are satisfiable)

memory_candidates.content: KampBypass.lean Until/Since backward direction closed by restructuring formula to encode exact 1-var NF types: (char_kp1 nf_t₀) ∧ ((char_kp1 nf_x₀) U top). Key insight: nf_agreement_from_shared_nf converts single NF satisfaction to full NF agreement. Combined with prior_2var_transfer_until (PriorComposition), this transfers h_eval₀ from M₀ to M. The formula must encode both x's and t's NF types to enable prior_2var_transfer.

cross_1var_from_2var (KampComposition) extracts the FIRST component's 1-var NF from 2-var agreement. For the SECOND component (t in [x,t]), there is no direct helper — nf_drop_last_cross also projects the first component (via castSucc). On Prior structures, the second component projection requires Prior-specific zone-matching (prior_second_1var_from_2var). On general linear orders, 2-var agreement does NOT determine the second component's 1-var NF.

PriorComposition.lean prior_nonconstenv_2var_agree_until IS true on Prior structures (comment in KampBypass saying 'FALSE' was incorrect — it's false on GENERAL linear orders but true on Prior). The file was removed from imports incorrectly. Re-adding it enables prior_2var_transfer_until which provides the one-directional transfer needed for KampBypass backward direction.
